title: Weighted estimates for Hodge-Maxwell systems
summary: We establish up to the boundary regularity estimates in weighted $L^{p}$ spaces with Muckenhoupt weights $A_{p}$ for weak solutions to the Hodge systems \begin{align*} d^{\ast}\left(Adω\right) + B^{\intercal}dd^{\ast}\left(Bω\right) = λBω+ f \quad \text{ in } Ω \end{align*} with either $ν\wedge ω$ and $ν\wedge d^{\ast}\left(Bω\right)$ or $ν\lrcorner Bω$ and $ν\lrcorner Adω$ prescribed on $\partialΩ.$ As a consequence, we prove the solvability of Hodge-Maxwell systems and derive Hodge decomposition theorems in weighted Lebesgue spaces.
